discussion_comments.comment_body:
The route does exist — it's served by the backend API service (separate repo), which registers `GET /container-tags/:containerTag` and returns `containerTag`, `name`, and `entityContext`. It's only missing from the typed client contract in `packages/lib/api.ts`, which is why this hook uses `disableValidation: true`. So settings hydrate fine in production.

The second part is a fair catch though: `resolveEntityContext()` falling back to the generic default on a failed fetch could overwrite a space's custom context (document POST upserts `entityContext` onto the space). Fixed by returning `undefined` in the catch instead, so a failed lookup sends nothing and the stored context is left untouched.
